title: AS2 new on chained member expressions uses wrong AVM1 opcode path
description:
compileNewExpr (compiler.ts:2634) pushes a dotted string like "mx.transitions.Tween" and emits ActionNewObject (0x40). ActionNewObject calls Ruffle's resolve() (not get_variable()), which does a FLAT scope lookup — it does NOT split on dots. So resolve("mx.transitions.Tween") returns undefined and the constructor call fails at runtime.

EVIDENCE:
- ruffle/core/src/avm1/activation.rs:1705 action_new_object calls self.resolve(fn_name)
- ruffle/core/src/avm1/activation.rs:2868 resolve() calls scope.resolve() — flat property lookup, no dot-splitting
- ruffle/core/src/avm1/activation.rs:2694 get_variable() is the one that splits on '.:' — used by ActionGetVariable, NOT ActionNewObject
- compiler.ts:2645-2647 has an incorrect comment claiming ActionNewObject performs dot-path resolution

Task 0867 was prematurely marked done; the fix it described was not implemented. The current code still pushes a flat dotted string.

FIX: For NewExpr where callee is a MemberExpr chain, use ActionNewMethod (0x53) instead:
- Stack layout for ActionNewMethod: TOP=method_name(string), next=object, next=numArgs, then args (deepest first)
- For 'new mx.transitions.Tween(a, b)': push args (b, a), push numArgs, compile 'mx.transitions' via GetVariable+GetMember chain, push 'Tween', emit 0x53
- For simple 'new ClassName()': ActionNewObject (0x40) with the identifier string is still correct (scope lookup finds a flat name)
- For 'new pkg.Class()' with depth>=2: ActionNewMethod with object=pkg, method='Class'
- The recursive case: 'new a.b.c.D()' → ActionNewMethod where object=(GetVariable('a')+GetMember('b')+GetMember('c')), method='D'

ActionNewMethod opcode reference: ruffle/swf/src/avm1/opcode.rs:78 NewMethod = 0x53

FILES: packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts (compileNewExpr at line 2634, memberExprToString at line 2623)
